headline: Sunny weekend family picks — 5–6 Sep
summary: Met Office: Sat dry and sunny ~20°C; Sun warmer ~24°C with any early drizzle clearing. Free/cheap dated picks at Llanishen Reservoir, Chapter and Hubs, plus Techniquest’s last A-Mazing Summer days and a toddler show at New Theatre.

notices.title: Llanishen Reservoir — early close Sunday
notices.detail: Site closes at 16:00 on Sunday 6 Sep for staff training. Plan morning or early-afternoon visits.

notices.title: National Museum Cardiff opening change
notices.detail: Open 10:00–17:00 Sat and Sun this weekend. From Monday 7 Sep the museum closes on Mondays.

datedPicks.title: Back to School kids activities
datedPicks.location: Llanishen Reservoir, Lisvane Road, Cardiff CF14 0BB
datedPicks.description: Explore Learning free educational games and activities aimed at ages 4–14. Drop in; good outdoor morning if the sun holds.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Free outdoor drop-in with a clear Saturday morning window — strong “if you do one thing” pick for a sunny weekend.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Drop-in 10:00–13:00; Explore Learning games aimed ~4–14. Pair with reservoir walks after.
datedPicks.bookingStatus: free drop-in · Eventbrite listing for details

datedPicks.title: Indie Collectives market at WMC
datedPicks.description: Curated South Wales makers, bakers and small creatives trading inside WMC. Pair with a Bay walk; coincides with separate 999 Day activity outside.
datedPicks.statusNote: Confirm stall hours on the day at WMC.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Indoor Bay browse that pairs with a walk; local makers rather than a tourist staple.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Confirm stall hours on the day at WMC; coincides with separate 999 Day activity outside.

datedPicks.title: Homework Club — Ely and Caerau Hub
datedPicks.location: Ely and Caerau Hub, Cowbridge Road West, Ely, Cardiff CF5 5BQ
datedPicks.description: Weekly Saturday quiet study space with help using hub resources. Clear homework early, then enjoy the rest of a sunny weekend.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Free community hub session with practical value — clear homework early, then enjoy the weekend.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Ely and Caerau Hub; free printing for schoolwork. Weekly Saturday slot.

datedPicks.title: Techniquest — A-Mazing Summer (Sat)
datedPicks.location: Techniquest, Stuart Street, Cardiff Bay CF10 5BW
datedPicks.description: Mirror Maze, musical exhibits, Battle of the Bangs and Create & Shape Zone. Last weekend of this special programme — ends Sunday.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Last weekend of A-Mazing Summer — solid indoor paid option labelled as backup, not the hero.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Book ahead; full-day from £15.45. Ends Sunday.

datedPicks.title: Faces of Culture mask workshop
datedPicks.location: Chapter, Market Road, Canton, Cardiff CF5 1QE
datedPicks.description: Free drop-in mask-making for ages 7–13, led by Young Producers responding to the Dream Inheritances exhibition. Masks take about 20–30 minutes.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Free drop-in mask workshop with clear age fit (7–13) — distinctive local cultural session.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Masks ~20–30 mins; drop-in during the 2-hour session from 12:00.

datedPicks.title: Fun For Little Ones — Tribute to Ms Rachel
datedPicks.cost: From £20 · under-12-months free on lap (babes-in-arms ticket)
datedPicks.description: Interactive toddler tribute show with sing-alongs, puppets and screen content. Selling fast — book via New Theatre / Trafalgar Tickets.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Clear 0–4 age fit and an official ticket path — useful paid toddler option when free slots do not cover under-fives.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Selling fast; under-12-months free on lap with babes-in-arms ticket.
datedPicks.bookingStatus: paid tickets · book via Trafalgar / New Theatre

datedPicks.title: Techniquest — A-Mazing Summer (final day)
datedPicks.location: Techniquest, Stuart Street, Cardiff Bay CF10 5BW
datedPicks.description: Last day of A-Mazing Summer: Mirror Maze, sound exhibits, science theatre and hands-on zones. Strong indoor backup if Sunday morning starts damp.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Final day of the special programme — indoor backup if Sunday starts damp.

evergreen.title: National Museum Cardiff
evergreen.description: Art, natural history and science galleries in the city centre. Under-16s must visit with an adult. Free day tickets recommended.

evergreen.title: St Fagans National Museum of History
evergreen.description: Historic buildings, open meadows and indoor galleries — dependable all-weather family day out west of the city.

evergreen.title: Lisvane & Llanishen Reservoirs
evergreen.time: Open daily · café & trails (Sun 6 Sep closes 16:00)
evergreen.cost: Free to walk · paid water activities
evergreen.description: Circular paths, woodland story trail, visitor-centre café and optional watersports. Ideal sunny outdoor backup after the Saturday kids session.

evergreen.title: Bute Park
evergreen.description: Central parkland beside Cardiff Castle — paths, play space and room to roam without booking. Perfect for the fine weekend forecast.

evergreen.title: Techniquest
evergreen.time: Check opening times and tickets before travel
evergreen.description: Hands-on science centre in Cardiff Bay. After A-Mazing Summer ends, use the visit page for regular opening times and prices.
